summary: Completed all four plan phases: a push_branch grant now binds, at mint and consume time, to the named ref's own commit (via refs/heads/<ref>) instead of bare HEAD, fixing both the too-strict and too-loose failure modes for a non-checked-out-ref grant while leaving checked-out-branch behavior unchanged. Added nine new/amended suite cases across two test files, one clarifying doc sentence, and redeployed (fixing one shellcheck finding forward along the way) to a clean 41-check verify.

artifacts.summary: Implementation summary for the ref-bound push grant: production changes, suite cases, doc sentence, and redeploy verification.
